The '''Knooda system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Askarian sector/Legends|Askarian sector]], a part of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] regions known as the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]].<ref name="Slice" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Knooda system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square O-12.<ref name="EAOC" />
